newsitem.title: FRANCE: Cap Gemini may sell Cisi stake.
newsitem.headline: Cap Gemini may sell Cisi stake.

text.p: French computer systems house Cap Gemini would envisage selling its 36 percent holding in its Cisi affiliate, a senior Cap Gemini executive said on Tuesday.
"We are potential sellers of our holding," executive committee member Pierre Hessler said at a news conference on Cap's 1996 results.

State-owned CEA-Industrie CEPfi.PA, which owns 64 percent of Cisi, has said it wants to sell its stake as a block or in pieces, Hessler said. He added that electronics group Compagnie des Signaux has said it is interested in buying Cisi.
Cap earlier posted provisional 1996 net attributable profit of 280 million francs, up from 52 million in 1995.
